cumulative-layout-shift.description: Cumulative Layout Shift measures the movement of visible elements within the viewport. [Learn more](https://web.dev/cls/).
cumulative-layout-shift.title: Cumulative Layout Shift

interaction-to-next-paint.description: Interaction to Next Paint measures page responsiveness. [Learn more](https://web.dev/inp/).
interaction-to-next-paint.title: Interaction to Next Paint

largest-contentful-paint.description: Largest Contentful Paint marks the time at which the largest content element becomes visible. [Learn more](https://web.dev/lcp/).
largest-contentful-paint.title: Largest Contentful Paint

render-blocking-resources.description: Resources are blocking the first paint of your page. Consider delivering critical JS/CSS inline and deferring all non-critical JS/styles. [Learn more](https://web.dev/render-blocking-resources/).
render-blocking-resources.title: Eliminate render-blocking resources

total-blocking-time.description: Total Blocking Time sums all time periods with long tasks. [Learn more](https://web.dev/tbt/).
total-blocking-time.title: Total Blocking Time

total-byte-weight.description: Large network payloads cost users real money and are highly correlated with long load times. [Learn more](https://web.dev/total-byte-weight/).
total-byte-weight.title: Avoid enormous network payloads

unused-javascript.description: Reduce unused JavaScript and defer loading scripts until they are required. [Learn more](https://web.dev/unused-javascript/).
unused-javascript.title: Reduce unused JavaScript

uses-http2.description: HTTP/2 offers many benefits over HTTP/1.1. [Learn more](https://web.dev/uses-http2/).
uses-http2.title: Use HTTP/2

uses-responsive-images.description: Serve images that are appropriately-sized to save cellular data. [Learn more](https://web.dev/uses-responsive-images/).
uses-responsive-images.title: Properly size images

uses-text-compression.description: Text-based resources should be served with compression. [Learn more](https://web.dev/uses-text-compression/).
uses-text-compression.title: Enable text compression

valid-source-maps.description: Source maps translate minified code to the original source. [Learn more](https://web.dev/source-maps/).
valid-source-maps.title: Valid source maps
